sections.position: Marketing Manager @ Eden Health Center Qatar
sections.bio:
I help HealthTech, MedTech, healthcare SaaS and medical brands communicate complex ideas in a credible, clear and engaging way.

My content covers digital health, AI in healthcare, medical technology, healthcare marketing, patient experience and innovation across Qatar and the MENA region.

With a background in surgical technology, healthcare operations, marketing and medical innovation, I combine clinical understanding with strong storytelling and commercial insight.

I create thought-leadership posts, product reviews, educational content, campaign storytelling, event coverage and authentic brand collaborations for an audience of healthcare professionals, founders, innovators and decision-makers.

Best suited for brands looking to build trust, visibility and authority within the healthcare and innovation ecosystem.

posts.text:
Proud to share that my work was featured by The Peninsula Qatar in an article highlighting Arab innovators elevating scientific practice through Qatar Foundation’s Stars of Science – Season 17.

In the article, my project was recognized among the standout innovations: an AR-assisted surgical navigation tool designed to support surgical decision-making and help surgeons operate with greater clarity and safety.

As I shared with The Peninsula:
“When lives are at stake, you don’t start from scratch, you make what’s working even safer.”

For me, this journey is not only about invention. It is about improving what already exists in healthcare, reducing risks, and building technology that can support clinicians in real-world surgical environments.

Grateful to Qatar Foundation, Qatar Science & Technology Park (QSTP), and Stars of Science for creating an ecosystem where Arab innovators can transform ideas into impactful solutions.

This is only the beginning.
🔗 Article: https://lnkd.in/gU2ra2fG 

#StarsOfScience #QatarFoundation #QSTP #ThePeninsula #HealthTech #DigitalHealth #SurgicalInnovation #AugmentedReality #ArabInnovators #Innovation #HealthcareInnovation

This opportunity represents an important milestone in my journey at the intersection of #leadership, #innovation, and community #impact. Being part of a global cohort of emerging leaders is a powerful reminder that growth starts with reflection, purpose, and action.

 The journey has just begun 🚀

🚀 Introducing Q Test — a new content series where I test innovation, smart products, and health-tech ideas.

For the first episode, I start with a 6-in-1 Health Monitor - LinkTop  — a connected device designed to bring multiple health measurements into one simple ecosystem.

What makes this product interesting is not only the device itself, but the full experience around it:

✅ Health monitor device  
✅ Mobile app  
✅ Dashboard interface  
✅ Connected health data  
✅ Simple user experience  

This is the direction I believe healthcare innovation is moving toward:  
less complexity, more clarity, and smarter tools that help people understand their health faster.

In Q Test, I will explore products, technologies, and ideas that can change how we live, work, and manage health.

I’m Q — and this is Q Test.  
Let’s test innovation.

#QTest #Innovation #HealthTech #DigitalHealth #ProductInnovation #AI #HealthcareTechnology #SmartDevices #FutureOfHealthcare

For a long time, I realized that dry eye care was not only a clinical challenge — it was also a workflow challenge.

Different tests.
Disconnected reports.
Subjective decisions.
Unclear patient journeys.

So instead of thinking only about treatment, I started thinking about systems.

I worked on designing a complete Dry Eye Intelligence Workflow focused on:
• Structured assessment
• Clinical data analysis
• Patient scoring
• Personalized treatment pathways
• Follow-up optimization
• Better patient understanding

The goal was simple:
Transform fragmented care into a connected, technology-driven experience.

This project reflects how I see the future of healthcare:
not just more technology, but smarter systems built around patients, clarity, and better clinical decisions.

Healthcare innovation is no longer only about devices or AI models.
It’s about designing workflows that make care more intelligent, measurable, and human-centered.

Excited to continue building at the intersection of:
Healthcare × Technology × Patient Experience × System Design.

#HealthcareInnovation #DigitalHealth #Ophthalmology #DryEye #HealthTech #AIHealthcare #HealthcareTransformation #MedicalInnovation #PatientExperience #ClinicalWorkflow #HealthcareSystems #Qatar

Q TEST — Episode 2

Today, I’m testing Activa Dry Eye Treatment — a smart technology designed to support people dealing with dry eye symptoms.

Dry eye is not only about discomfort.
In many cases, it can be linked to the meibomian glands, which help produce the oily layer of the tear film.

What makes Activa interesting is its approach
 - Controlled heat
 - Gentle vibration massage
 - Support for meibomian gland function
 - Better tear film quality
 - More comfortable dry eye care experience

This is where healthcare innovation becomes exciting:
when technology makes treatment more structured, more comfortable, and easier for patients to understand.

I’m Q — and this is Q TEST.
Let’s test innovation.

#QTest #Innovation #HealthTech #DryEye #EyeCare #Ophthalmology #MedicalTechnology #DigitalHealth #HealthcareInnovation

sections.title: Time from booking to post
sections.body: I usually deliver the first draft within 48 hours of receiving the final brief, key messages and campaign assets. Once the content is approved, I can publish within 24–48 hours according to the agreed campaign schedule. Faster turnaround may be available for launches, events or time-sensitive campaigns when confirmed in advance

sections.title: What I offer
sections.body:
I create credible, engaging content for HealthTech, MedTech, healthcare SaaS and innovation-focused brands looking to reach healthcare professionals and decision-makers across Qatar and the MENA region.

Available collaboration formats include sponsored LinkedIn posts, thought-leadership content, product or platform reviews, educational storytelling, event coverage, campaign launches and short-form video content.

Every collaboration is adapted to the brand’s objectives while maintaining an authentic voice, clear messaging and strong professional credibility. I can support the full process from concept and copywriting to content creation, publishing and post-campaign performance reporting.

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body:
I bring a rare combination of clinical knowledge, healthcare marketing experience and hands-on innovation expertise. This allows me to understand complex medical and technology products, then translate them into clear, credible content that professionals can trust.

My audience includes healthcare professionals, founders, managers, marketers and innovators across Qatar and the wider MENA region.

I focus on authentic partnerships rather than generic advertising. Each collaboration is built around the brand’s goals, audience and key message, while keeping the content educational, professional and engaging.

Brands work with me for healthcare credibility, regional market understanding, strong storytelling and content that makes complex ideas easier to understand.
